component.name: Cliamp
component.summary: Unofficial desktop fork of the cliamp music player

description.p: Unofficial fork of cliamp, the terminal music player by Bjarne Øverli. This package is not an official cliamp release. Official builds are published at https://cliamp.stream.
The desktop app plays local files, internet radio, podcasts, and the online sources the engine supports. Playback follows the system default audio output.
